context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useCustomer SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs for retrieving the logged-in customer's profile. It assesses proper hook invocation, correct handling of null (logged out) state, loading state, and display of profile fields.

checklist.name: useCustomer hook usage
checklist.description: The useCustomer hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and called without arguments

checklist.name: Logged-in state display
checklist.description: When useCustomer returns a customer object, firstName, lastName, and email are rendered from the customer data

checklist.name: Null (logged out) state
checklist.description: When useCustomer returns null or undefined, the component renders a 'not logged in' message

checklist.name: Loading state
checklist.description: When useCustomer data is undefined (still loading), the component renders a loading indicator
